'''Outpost Delta''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] outpost located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]]. It was used by the forces of the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />
